submission.justification: Algorithm-L1 gives the highest signal efficiency at the 8 kHz allocated rate in the current emulation: 92.65% at 30 GeV, versus 84.5% for L3 and 73.9% for L2 at the same threshold. The L1 efficiency curve peaks in the 30-35 GeV range (92.65% at 30, 92.50% at 35, 89.24% at 25, 87.19% at 20), so 30 GeV is the best threshold tested. The 2025 summary figures are consistent with the new run. Deployability: candidate_specs.md states all three candidates fit the FPGA resource budget, and links.md says the 25 Gb/s links have enough bandwidth. No document gives L1's latency budget, so firmware feasibility of the iterative clustering should be confirmed before the Q4 firmware freeze.

requirements.requirement: Algorithm must be one of the three candidates in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: Algorithm-L1 (iterative topological clustering with learned calibration) is listed in candidate_specs.md.

requirements.requirement: Algorithm must be deployable in Level-1 trigger hardware
requirements.evidence: candidate_specs.md says all candidates fit the FPGA resource budget (LUTs, DSPs); links.md says 25 Gb/s links suffice. No latency analysis for the iterative algorithm was found, so this rests on the spec document and should be confirmed before firmware freeze.

requirements.requirement: Highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated rate (8 kHz)
requirements.evidence: Emulated efficiency at 8 kHz: L1 92.65% at 30 GeV, the best of the three candidates (L3 84.55%, L2 73.86% at 30 GeV). L1 was also tested at 20, 25 and 35 GeV, and 30 GeV was the best of those.

requirements.requirement: Submit one recommended algorithm and threshold
